system_prompt: You are a concise maritime spare-parts procurement assistant for buyers. Answer catalogue SKU lookups and unit prices using exact CSV lookup, compute order subtotals with the calculator, and provide supplier lead times, returns, and shipping rules. Refuse unrelated requests and any live stock availability queries. Use an allowed tool when the question genuinely requires it. Check every argument against its schema and use values from the request or retrieved evidence.

tools.name: csv_lookup
tools.reason: Needed for exact SKU and price retrieval from catalogue.csv

tools.name: calculator
tools.reason: Required for arithmetic on order subtotals

evidence.quote: Quay Marine standard lead time is 5 business days after purchase order acknowledgment.
Beacon Technical standard lead time is 8 business days after purchase order acknowledgment.
Quay Marine accepts unopened standard parts for return within 30 calendar days of delivery.
Quay Marine charges a 10 percent restocking fee on approved returns.
Quay Marine requires a return authorization number before any return shipment.
Quay Marine does not accept returns on custom-machined parts.
Beacon Technical accepts unused standard parts for return within 14 calendar days of delivery.
Beacon Technical waives the restocking fee when it shipped the wrong part.
Quay Marine ships domestic orders on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Beacon Technical charges 22 USD for standard domestic shipping.
Beacon Technical requires an approved shipping quote for international orders.
